title: Astronomers may have discovered the first moon beyond our Solar System
caption:
Astronomers analyzing data from the Very Large Telescope in Chile have spotted what could be the first moon candidate beyond our solar system. The catch is that this bizarre satellite is as massive as Jupiter and circles an intermediate failed star.

Source: Sciencedaily - Astronomers may have discovered the first moon beyond our Solar System

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261023023736.htm
